title: Slicer for Orac

content:
a slicing fx for orac

1 record , 4 players 

trig div = trigger division off master clock, 0 = none
play rate = playback rate, negative = reverse
slide = select slice , 0 = random

slicer also accepts key or note input 
octave = which player is targeted (60=1, 72 = 2 etc) 


to install, unzip this file into media/orac/usermodules
based on slicerec/play from
http://www.katjaas.nl/slicejockey/slicejockey.html

change log
1.1add mix, 2x playback, note octave selects player, remove enable

1.0 initial release
